caption: The drawing depicts a large wooden cross positioned vertically, with a central human-like figure attached to it. This central figure has a black beard, a hat, extended arms, and its attire is colored in shades of yellow, green, blue, red, and black, forming geometrical and symmetrical patterns on its torso and arms. The figure's face shows distinct features with black hair, and it wears black shoes. Below the feet of the central figure, there is a horizontal wooden plank resting on the upright post. On this plank, six smaller human-like figures are arranged in a row, each wearing clothing colored in black, white, red, and blue, with some figures also wearing hats. Their styles and poses are similar, with varying facial features and headpieces. The entire composition is rendered on a pale background using muted colors, and the drawing has a deliberate, folk-art quality. The name “M. PARISH” appears at the bottom right corner.
title: San Acacio
